briefing: 今日导读：AI行业内有多个值得关注的事件，Relay 的关闭和团队转移至谷歌显示了行业整合趋势，Hugging Face 的资源利用率提升展示了效率优化，Roboflow推出30种CV模型平台推动了技术选型，Groq的融资和转型显示了市场策略变化。
highlights: 今日看点：Relay的关闭和团队整合到谷歌显示出AI行业内部的整合趋势，这预示着大公司对创新小团队的吸收可能帮助加速AI技术在大型平台的应用。而Groq的重大融资与业务转型反映了AI芯片厂商向云端服务的转变，表明行业重心正逐渐向软件和服务层转移。此外，Hugging Face的效率提升和Roboflow对CV模型的集中展示，进一步说明AI模型和平台的精细化运作是未来的关注重点。

events.title: AI 自动化初创公司 Relay 关闭

articles.title: Anthropic explains how Claude’s invisible text watermarks will work
articles.text: Anthropic has clarified how it's planning to apply invisible watermarks to Claude-generated text in order to comply with Europe's AI transparency rules. On Friday, Anthropic announced that Claude's text marking system is "a version of the SynthID-Text approach" - an open-source watermarking technology developed by Google DeepMind that creates detectable patterns using wording probabilities. This watermarking feature, alongside C2PA support for Claude-processed images, is being introduced to meet Anthropic's obligations under the European Union's AI Act , which requires synthetic audio, image, video, and text to include machine-readable marks … Read the full story at The Verge.
